relevance_note: Table 3 of this SAID cohort contains a section "A20 haploinsufficiency (TNFAIP3)" with four patients (Pt. 40-Pt. 43) whose TNFAIP3 variants are printed.
method_note: Read only the paper, schema_ha20_v5.json and extraction_rules_v1.md (no web, no memory). Table 3 has patients as rows, so labels are the paper's own (Pt. 40-Pt. 43); column headers used: 'Patient (age of diagnosis, years/sex)', 'Age of onset of symptoms', 'Clinical features', 'Laboratory features', 'Family history', 'Initial diagnosis', 'Molecular details', 'Treatment details', 'Follow-up duration and outcomes'. In scope: the four TNFAIP3 patients in the 'A20 haploinsufficiency (TNFAIP3)' block of Table 3 plus two relatives described in relation to Pt. 40 ('Mother is carrier for the same variant', 'When younger brother also developed recurrent oral ulcers'). The other members of this 78-patient SAID cohort (other genes, PFAPA, Blau) get no rows; the stated total is in publications.cohort_size_as_stated. Pt. 40's variant string is recorded as 'c.1504C>T' (shortest contiguous text giving the variant); the cell prints 'exon 7;c.1504C>T; p.Arg502Trp Heterozygous missense'. Variant type is given only where the authors state a class: Pt. 40 'missense'. Pts 41-43 print no class word, so variant_type is 'not reported' (D-29 forbids deriving it from the HGVS string, e.g. 'fs'). Pathogenicity: Pt. 41 'Novel Likely pathogenic', Pts 42 and 43 'VUS'. Inheritance for Pt. 40 is 'inherited maternal' because the mother carries the same variant; no parental testing is reported for Pts 41-43. A variant row for the mother keeps variant_original_string 'not reported' because the paper ties her only to the 'same variant' and prints no description for her. The brother with recurrent oral ulcers is not given a variant row: 'while the younger sibling does not carry this variant'; I read 'the younger sibling' as the same younger brother (not certain). 'NA' cells (laboratory, treatment, follow-up for Pts 41-43) and empty cells are not reported. No ' / ' stacked cells occur in Table 3; no cell was assigned positionally (D-31). No table legend defines '-' or '0' as absent, so no symbol was read as absence; the only 'excluded' rows come from explicit wording ('Gut Biopsy: no vasculitis', 'Ferritin normal.', 'No increase in Double negative TCRab+ T cells'). Checklist 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)' is observed for Pt. 42 from 'Direct coombs test 3+' and left not reported for Pt. 40 despite 'ANA, ANCA: negative' plus 'HLAB51: positive' (ANA is narrower than the composite item). Contradictions/oddities: the numbers are garbled by conversion ('107 patients', '78 patients', '38%%', '1five patients', Discussion 'In our cohort (8/49) have died') - I used the stated 78 for cohort size; the text says 'Patient 40 was 2 years old' at presentation while Table 3 gives onset '6 M' and diagnosis '6 y'; Pt. 43's only clinical entry is 'Osteomyelitis/CGD'.
